title: Broncos have signed GM George Paton to a five-year deal

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos have signed GM George Paton to a five-year deal
sources.description: BREAKING NEWS! According to NFL Network’s league insider Tom Pelissero, the Denver Broncos are signing General Manager George Paton to a new five-year contract. The Broncos have since confirmed and announced that they have signed GM George Paton to a new five-year contract through the 2030 season. Denver Broncos Owner and CEO Greg Penner announced […]
